extractionFacts.statement: When the project is run locally and the /login route is opened, the Google GSI request reports HTTP 403 and GSI_LOGGER origin-not-allowed for the client ID shown in the incident.
Find and fix the cause so the Google login entry loads at the agreed local address without the GSI 403 and can initiate the existing login flow.
Record the verified root cause and applicable local origin or environment configuration.
Determine separately whether the unload permissions-policy warning is related to the 403, and do not treat it as the same root cause without evidence.
Keep production Google login behavior unchanged and do not expand the change to unrelated login functionality.

argv: const { chromium } = require('playwright'); (async()=>{ const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true}); const page=await browser.newPage(); const gsi=[]; const errors=[]; page.on('response',r=>{if(r.url().includes('accounts.google.com/gsi/button'))gsi.push(r.status())}); page.on('console',m=>{if(/GSI_LOGGER|origin is not allowed|403/.test(m.text()))errors.push(m.text())}); await page.goto('http://localhost:4001/zh-CN/login',{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded',timeout:60000}); await page.waitForTimeout(8000); const frame=page.frameLocator('iframe[src*="accounts.google.com/gsi/button"]'); const button=frame.getByRole('button'); if(gsi.length!==1||gsi[0]!==200)throw new Error('expected one successful GSI button response, got '+JSON.stringify(gsi)); if(errors.length)throw new Error('unexpected GSI errors: '+JSON.stringify(errors)); if(await button.count()!==1)throw new Error('Google sign-in button is unavailable'); const popupPromise=page.waitForEvent('popup',{timeout:10000}); await button.click(); const popup=await popupPromise; await popup.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded'); if(!popup.url().startsWith('https://accounts.google.com/'))throw new Error('unexpected Google login popup URL: '+popup.url()); await popup.close(); await browser.close(); })().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})
